what: MIRROR-ORPHAN CHECK LAGS THE 2026-11-01 ALPACA SUPERSET RULE: scripts/ops/check_mirror_orphans.py only classifies a mirror-without-live-twin position as benign when the LIVE side_filter suppresses that side (side_filter_superset, 2026-11-13). The operator's 2026-11-01 rule makes alpaca_portfolio a SUPERSET of alpaca_live (affordability proxies at full size, shorting, symbols live cannot trade), so a live affordability REFUSAL leaves a legitimate mirror-only position that the checker reports as ORPHAN and the watch fails nightly with a high-priority alert. Fix: classify a mirror position as superset when the live twin's package was refused/dry for affordability (read the package's per-account refusal reason, the same resolver the coordinator uses), keep ORPHAN for anything else, and keep a planted-orphan control. Paper only; no real-money exposure.
